info.description: This documentation describes the DCS (Gitea) API.
info.title: DCS (Gitea) API

get.description:
Returns the repository at the given git reference as a Scripture Burrito (SB) archive.
Resource Container (rc), translationStudio (ts) and translationCore (tc) repositories are
converted to SB on the fly; repositories already in SB format are archived as they are.
Any other repository returns 404. The same archive can be downloaded without an API token
from the repository's HTML URL, `/{owner}/{repo}/sb/{archive}`. The plain (unconverted) git
archive is available from `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/archive/{archive}`.
get.summary: Get a Scripture Burrito archive of a repository

parameters.description: owner of the repo
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: name of the repo
parameters.name: repo

parameters.description: the git reference (branch, tag or commit) with the archive format appended, either .zip or .tar.gz (e.g. master.zip, v1.tar.gz)
parameters.name: archive

200.description: the Scripture Burrito archive; Content-Disposition names it {repo}-{ref}-sb.{zip|tar.gz}

400.description: the archive format is not .zip or .tar.gz

404.description: the ref does not exist, or the repository is not an rc, ts, tc or sb repository

get.summary: List owners in the catalog based on the given criteria

parameters.description: list only the given owners(s) if they have entries in the catalog meeting the criteria given (e.g. way to test an owner has a given language or subject)
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: list only those with the given repo(s). To match multiple, give the parameter multiple times or give a list comma delimited.
parameters.name: repo

parameters.description: list only those with entries in the given language(s). To match multiple, give the parameter multiple times or give a list comma delimited. Will perform an exact match (case insensitive) unlesss partialMatch=true
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description: list only those that are (true) or are not (false) a gatetway language
parameters.name: is_gl

parameters.description: list only those of the given stage or lower, with low to high being: "prod" - return only those of production releases (default); "preprod" - return only those of all (production & pre-production) releases; "latest" - return only those of all releases and the default branch; "other" - return all, including other branches and tags [aliases: "branch", "tag"]
parameters.name: stage

parameters.description: resource subject. Multiple values are ORed.
parameters.name: subject

parameters.description: resource flavorType. Multiple values are ORed.
parameters.name: flavorType

parameters.description: resource flavor. Multiple values are ORed.
parameters.name: flavor

parameters.description: resource abbreviation (identifier). Multiple values are ORed.
parameters.name: abbreviation

parameters.description: content format (usfm, text, markdown, etc.). Multiple values are ORed.

parameters.description: checking level. Returns items with a checking level equal or greater than the number given

parameters.description: book (ingredient identifier). Multiple values are ORed
parameters.name: book

parameters.description: metadata type. Multiple values are ORed
parameters.name: metadataType

parameters.description: metadata version. Does not apply if metadataType is not given. Multiple values are ORed

parameters.description: If true, many of the above fields will do a partial match, allowing characters to come before or after your given value, default is false
parameters.name: partialMatch

parameters.description: topic of a repo. Multiple values are ORed. If a repo of this topic has a catalog entry, its owner will be listed.
parameters.name: topic

parameters.description: Entries with a repository without this topic will be returned. Multiple values are ANDed.
parameters.name: withoutTopic
